configuration_contract.operation: Edit employer records in data, not application code; enabled=false removes from active watchlist without deleting historical job evidence.
configuration_contract.add_employer: Append unique employer ID, name, career URL, keywords and target locations; no hardcoded company switch statements.
configuration_contract.add_job_description: Store supplied description provenance and consent, assign job ID/source ID, code required/preferred skills with human review and update counts using documented denominator.
configuration_contract.eligibility_policy: Never infer worldwide remote eligibility from the word remote; preserve country, time-zone and onsite constraints.
